beyond_accuracy_definitions.ILD@10: mean over rows of the mean pairwise (1 - cosine) of the top-10 clusters; cosine of cluster columns of the training user x cluster booking-count matrix
beyond_accuracy_definitions.ARP@10: mean training popularity share of the recommended clusters; ARP_ratio = ARP / mean training share of the booked clusters (1 = no bias)
beyond_accuracy_definitions.head10_slot_share: share of top-10 slots taken by the 10 most popular training clusters (head10_target_share = share of booked clusters in that head)
beyond_accuracy_definitions.exposure_gini: Gini of how often each cluster appears in the top-10 lists (0 = equal exposure)
beyond_accuracy_definitions.per_destination: destinations with >= 20 rows; booked-cluster coverage = share of the clusters booked there that appear in at least one top-10 list there
